title: Tavern 0.6.166 — reduce shaker HUD processing
native_evidence_scope: Exclude inactive graphical children from layout using unchanged visibility selectors and cache unchanged placed-shaker display projections. Preserve original timing, coordinates, ingredients, recipes, assets, native controls and other addon HUDs. No measured device-latency improvement or rendered-client acceptance claimed.
public_notes_inline:
